verdict.rationale: Canny explicitly offers a Changelog product ('Announce what you shipped, show customers you heard them, and turn closed feedback into retention and upgrades') as a dedicated feature area, directly matching the story of closing the loop with customers on shipped features. Missing for 10: no evidence of workflow automation linking closed feedback items to changelog entries, no screenshots/hands-on detail on publishing flow, and no independent/user corroboration beyond marketing copy.
